categoryC.rule: Applies to PTKP status K/3 (annual PTKP Rp 72,000,000). Non-NPWP surcharge applies 120% multiplier to the base PPh 21 tax rate under PMK 168/2023.

ter.boundaryConvention: lower bound EXCLUSIVE of previous bracket max (min value is inclusive integer rupiah), upper bound INCLUSIVE (s.d. / sampai dengan)
